title: Approved program baseline v1.1 — four-phase development and Settings & Help scope
body:
## Owner-approved program decision (22 Oct 2026)
OpsControl is a solo-developer, AI-assisted project. Adopt four program phases: (1) Development: implement all approved functional scope; (2) Manual & Automated Testing: comprehensive UAT; (3) Improvements & Bug Fixes: stabilization; (4) Deployment & Release: production readiness. Essential unit/integration tests, security/customer-isolation checks, migration preservation, lint/build, critical backend coverage >=80%, and required CI **remain mandatory during Phase 1**. No blanket postponement of technical verification.

## Product scope addition
Add **OpsControl Settings & Help** to approved product architecture:
- My Profile & Preferences: user profile, account security, display and notification preferences; accessible from profile menu.
- Application Settings: admin-authorized platform configuration, global defaults, monitoring/integration/security/retention parameters with audit trails and safe secret handling. Do not duplicate resource-specific configuration in Resource Management.
- Help & Knowledge: user manual, technical documentation, provider SOPs/runbooks, FAQ and troubleshooting. Restrict internal SOPs appropriately.

## Architecture invariants
Resource Management owns customer organizations, canonical resource inventory, agents/collectors and collection configuration. Access Management owns provider workforce departments, employees and RBAC. Compute Instances, Data Pipelines and API Endpoints are operational monitoring views. Each VM/EC2 belongs to one customer; Kubernetes clusters may have multiple explicitly authorized customer associations with strict attribution/isolation. Pentaho remains read-only monitoring.

## Audit and planning requirements
First conduct full source-level and execution audit of exact current main SHA, reconcile approved ARCH-001/ENG-001, UI-001–023, OC-IMP-001–018, AUD01–08 and sprint 12–42 scope; produce source-path/verification-backed Development Completion Master Plan grouped DEV-01 through DEV-06, with Settings & Help explicitly assigned to DEV-01 (UI/profile/help) and DEV-06 (secured platform settings). Preserve unrecovered source gaps, distinguish implementation from verification/UAT/release.

## PR policy
PR #41 is **not assumed merged**. Resolve its reported 64.52% coverage versus unchanged 80% gate, red required CI, and preservation/security/browser gates before any merge; then verify resulting main SHA and audit it. Historical owner-reported UAT PASS without deployment provenance is not independent UAT acceptance. PR #33 remains protected/unmodified. Do not weaken gates or deploy to production. This issue records planning approval, not completed implementation or execution audit.
